title: Bloop Stack
description: Drop goo creatures into a jar, merge matching pairs up eight tiers to the Kingloop, and don't let the pile cross the line.

title: Tidy Tiles
description: Drag tile shapes onto an 8x8 grid and clear full rows and columns. A new daily puzzle with a twist, plus an endless mode.

title: Tray Disaster
description: Tilt a waiter's tray to keep a growing stack of absurd dishes balanced down the diner aisle while hazards jostle it. Game over is the bill.

title: Rush Lane
description: Tap an arrow to send it sliding off the board along its lane. Blocked? It bumps back and costs a heart. Clear every arrow to win.

title: Potion Pour
description: Tap a vial to lift it, tap another to pour: sort every shelf of potions into pure colours. Limited undos and one extra vial keep every dead end explained, never unfair.

title: Petal Patch
description: A logic garden: place one ladybug in every row, column and flower bed, never touching. A wrong guess costs a petal. Endless run from 4x4 to 9x9, plus one shared daily garden.

title: Loop Break
description: A watchmaker's puzzle: turn one ring and every ring linked to it turns too. Line up all the gaps before your moves run out and the lock springs open. 24 levels plus a daily medallion.
